signatures.description: QA chaos cells truncate a project state file and ask for next-start crash behavior (bunker QA-BUNKER-B12/9 class). What worked: do NOT assume the truncated file is the one the code reads - grep first (bunker reads .vfs/graph/edges.jsonl; the truncated graph.db is the Hilo CLI store). Pin the DEFINED behavior with table-driven tests: truncated mid-line -> warn+skip partial+load rest; missing/empty -> warn+empty graph+nil; unreadable -> returned error (skip chmod case under root); Reload after corruption converges on fresh state, never stale. Document the outcome table + name what is NOT read. RED-proof by flipping warn-and-skip to fail-loud. Judge re-runs the full suite, so gate evidence must include go test ./... exit 0.
